The main takeaway from our work is that

even though the fountain darter may not be the most charismatic or economically important species in the Edwards Aquifer, it can serve as an early indicator of the effects of changes in spring flows on other aquatic species, as well as the effects of changes of spring flows on the recreational, municipal, and industrial uses of the water.
the fountain darter is a resilient species that can withstand considerable reductions in spring flows before its population dynamics begin to be affected.
